title: Surreal Mechanical Eye
description: A giant detailed green eye with exposed mechanical gears and clockwork inside dominates the foreground. In the background, a woman with dark hair appears in profile beside an orange horse standing on a hill covered in pink flowers, with a silhouetted cloaked figure on a hill in front of a massive red moon under a starry night sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night featuring a massive highly detailed green human eye with intricate exposed clockwork gears and mechanical parts in the foreground. Behind it, a beautiful dark-haired woman in profile, an orange horse standing on a rolling green hill covered with glowing pink flowers, and a mysterious cloaked silhouette standing before an enormous blood-red full moon in a starry sky.
